# SilverSea 0.1.8

SilverSea now has its own app logo throughout the Windows setup and the app. You can also check for updates from **Profile settings** and restart when a new version is ready.

Discord sign-in now uses a secure PKCE login. The app ID is built in, so there are no credentials for players to enter and no app secret inside the installer. The Discord application must have this callback registered in its OAuth2 settings:

`http://127.0.0.1:43122/discord/callback`

## Install or update

Download **SilverSea-Setup.exe** below and run it. Your library and settings are kept when you install a newer version.
